notes.title: One Shell Straight to Hell release date reveal!
notes.content:
Fancy some exorcism? Then rejoice in knowing that [i][b]One Shell Straight To Hell[/b][/i] is coming to Steam on February 9, 2021! 

That’s right, Padre Alexander is back, heavily armed to fight off hordes of demons while doing his best to help the Halliwell family. Join the fight in [i][b]One Shell Straight To Hell[/b][/i], the isometric, dungeon-crawling roguelike shooter. 

[i][b]One Shell Straight To Hell[/b][/i] will descend you into ever-changing dungeons that overflow with demonic enemies and put your insane skills and over the top weapons to the test against the satanic hordes. To survive you must shout orders to your allies, lay your traps, and raise your gun to lay waste to your enemies. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1330370/One_Shell_Straight_to_Hell/

[b] Key Features: [/b]
[list]
[*]Perplexing monsters- Ranging from the possessed kitchen drawer to drunken long-dead pirate captains and... I almost forgot, demons... a lot of demons.
[*]Regular weapons using a variety of ammunition, holy weapons drawing on your faith, and unholy weapons craving for your blood.
[*]Skill tree that makes you stronger and adds to the strategy.
[*]Base building... at least kind of. You will be able to build small factories to prepare...
[*]Traps for your enemies.
[*]Global enchantments
[*]Power-ups
[*]Randomly generated ‘dungeon’ maps
[*]And some more crazy absurd stuff!
[/list]

Take a look at the newest trailer of [i][b]One Shell Straight To Hell[/b][/i]:  
[previewyoutube=PZkPm87qP6o;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: DARQ: Complete Edition is HERE!
notes.content:
Our friendly dev team Unfold Games has just released their award-winning game [b][i]DARQ[/i][/b] with a little extra on top. Apart from the original game, [b][i]DARQ: Complete Edition[/i][/b] contains two DLCs, including The Crypt, which is available to play today for the first time. 

If you already own the original DARQ, you can download both DLCs, [i][b]The Tower[/b][/i] and [b][i]The Crypt[/i][/b], for free.

While we know this news is not directly related to 2084 we wanted to share it with you since we’re pretty sure that if you like horror games, you’ll enjoy DARQ too!

Curious what awaits you in [b][i]DARQ[/i][/b]? Let us give you a little sneak peek:

[b][i]DARQ[/i][/b] will take you on a journey through a boy's dreams that quickly turn into a loop of nightmares. Lloyd, the main character, is trying to wake up, but unfortunately, each attempt sinks him deeper into his lucid subconscious-driven dreams. Lloyd has to adapt to the new world, re-learn gravity, and strain his mind and all of his senses in order to solve puzzles and sneak past the creatures guarding the shadowy corners of DARQ.

Sounds fascinating, doesn’t it?

[b]DARQ: Complete Edition is available on the following platforms:[/b]
[list]
[*] PC
[*] Xbox One
[*] PlayStation 4
[/list]

[i]Owners of the PlayStation 4 and Xbox One versions will get a free upgrade to the PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S version when it will release in 2021. DARQ: Complete Edition will also be released on Nintendo Switch early next year.[/i]


[u][b]Find out more and grab free digital gifts from DARQ here[/b][/u]:
[url=]https://www.feardemic-games.com/darq[/url]

Join Lloyd and help him wake up.
